proposals.title: Connector-declared evidence labels
proposals.resolution: Connector metadata may label an upstream result observed, modelled, or proxy; SELECT propagates the label without adding a parser op.

proposals.title: Positive entity union
proposals.resolution: Adopt the common positive case as list-valued SELECT.entity with deterministic union and deduplication; do not imply general intersection or difference.

proposals.title: Typed FILTER over records and source dimensions
General record-set intersection and difference
proposals.note: The positive union subset is already ALG-001; this proposal covers only semantics not supplied by list-valued SELECT.entity.

proposals.title: Multi-clause completeness
proposals.note: Adopt mandatory clause completeness and upstream clause splitting; BUNDLE remains deferred until cross-clause dependencies require it.

proposals.title: Causal requests remain typed asks
proposals.resolution_candidate: Compile causal intent to a typed DataRequest unless a future claim layer carries an explicit identification design; never overload observational COMPARE or ESTIMATE.

proposals.title: Discovery-rate saturation protocol
proposals.resolution: Saturation requires coverage and breaker pressure plus three consecutive post-freeze untouched holdouts of at least 40 rows, a flat discovery curve, complete guards, and immutable checksums.

proposals.title: Family-level discovery and absorption accounting
proposals.note: H20 showed that failing-row count and semantic novelty are different axes. A family closes only after one generalized repair, positive variants, adjacent negative guards, a full-wall regression, and a new untouched-bank contact; reports publish both family and row counts.

proposals.title: Pre-contact semantic gold lint gate
proposals.note: H20 admitted two singular-winner RANK golds without k:1 and one density ambiguity. Admission should lint rank cardinality, candidate coverage, distinct operands, complete unsupported phrases, source-gap versus hole status, and requested output form before the immutable checksum.

proposals.title: Output-form-sensitive diagnostic scoring
proposals.note: H20 first contact scored 0.917 coarsely but only 18/40 under strict audit. The diagnostic scorer should distinguish Records, count, presence, density, Series, Scalar, and Ranking including k; strict canonical audit remains the release gate.

proposals.title: Connector-declared annotation-layer admissibility
proposals.note: H21 pre-contact execution showed that arbitrary ANNOTATE layers can return an Answer with absent fields. Connectors should declare field type, unit, coverage, and provider; unsupported or insufficient layers fail closed with a source-gap DataRequest.

proposals.title: Fail-closed resolver morphology
proposals.note: H21 explicit gig-work platform was falsely routed to craft workshops because work prefix-matched workshop. Replace uncontrolled prefix equality with declared aliases or bounded morphology plus a resolver certificate.

proposals.title: Bounded endpoint-direction versus trend convention
proposals.resolution_candidate: From-to event wording such as did X go up/down denotes endpoint CHANGE; progressive or explicit trajectory wording denotes unary TREND; unresolved surfaces are rejected or carry alternative golds.

proposals.title: Same-quantity guard for temporal COMPARE orientation
proposals.resolution: Later-minus-earlier canonicalization applies only when both operands resolve to the same entity or quantity; cross-entity arithmetic preserves written order.

proposals.title: Fail-closed grain co-scoping for arithmetic
proposals.note: Contested remedy: provenance-only disclosure versus a DataRequest on incompatible grains. Not released.

proposals.title: Exact series-point selection
proposals.note: H18 showed that SELECT(time:null) cannot simultaneously mean a whole series and one latest scalar. Candidate surface is PICK or a restricted typed REDUCE.

proposals.title: Explicit source gaps are not semantic holes
proposals.resolution_candidate: Preserve explicitly requested unsupported literals and return a source-gap DataRequest; reserve holes for unresolved user meaning or references.

proposals.title: Connector-declared temporal admissibility
proposals.note: H19 showed that a current-snapshot record connector can silently accept historical time constraints and manufacture a trend or endpoint comparison. Connectors must declare time semantics and the executor must fail closed when the requested temporal evidence is unavailable.

proposals.title: Unbounded scalar change needs an interval policy
proposals.note: H19 exposed a conflict between absent-time-null series retrieval and a scalar 'how much did X change' request, which requires two endpoints. The framework must choose an explicit available-range convention or a typed interval clarification; benchmark golds must not invent two time holes ad hoc.
